uutiset.t: Furbank leads returning England trio for All Blacks visit
uutiset.s: England are boosted by the recovery and return of George Furbank, Seb Atkinson and Ollie Chessum to face New Zealand

uutiset.t: Scotland should be grateful for Townsend - Jones
uutiset.s: As he makes sweeping changes for Saturday's meeting with Japan, Scotland's Gregor Townsend is lauded for the job he has done by opposition head coach Eddie Jones.

uutiset.t: Ireland hooker Sheehan named at number eight for Springboks game
uutiset.s: Ireland captain Dan Sheehan is named at number eight for Saturday's highly anticipated Nations Championship match against world champions South Africa in Dublin.

uutiset.t: Five return for Wales' World Cup play-off final
uutiset.s: Ceri Holland is in the Wales squad for next month's Women's World Cup play-off final against Norway despite being out since September through injury.

uutiset.t: Premier League clubs to cover legal costs if Man City sponsors sue
uutiset.s: Premier League clubs vote to provide legal cover to the organisation's five board directors in the event Manchester City's sponsors sue them.

uutiset.t: Woods to design new golf course in Northern Ireland
uutiset.s: Tiger Woods is to design Northern Ireland's first new championship links golf course in more than a century.

uutiset.t: McCullum plans to use Brook and Banton as bowlers
uutiset.s: England white-ball coach Brendon McCullum believes that batters Harry Brook and Tom Banton can be genuine bowling options as they prepare for next year's World Cup.

uutiset.t: Will this be the tightest Championship promotion race ever?
uutiset.s: With five teams separated by just one point at the top of the Championship, could this be the best season yet?

uutiset.t: Magill returns to NI squad for Greece friendlies
uutiset.s: Northern Ireland manager Michael McArdle has made five changes to his squad for the upcoming friendlies against Greece, with the return of experienced striker Simone Magill among the notable returnees.

uutiset.t: Champion weightlifter loses arm after motorbike crash
uutiset.s: Commonwealth Games gold medallist Muhammad Hafizuddin Roslin has his right arm amputated above the elbow after a motorcycle accident in his native Malaysia.

uutiset.t: World marathon champion Jepchirchir gets three-year doping ban
uutiset.s: Reigning world marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir is banned for three years for a doping violation.

uutiset.t: 'I'm very healthy' - Kompany to return to dugout after health scare
uutiset.s: Bayern Munich boss Vincent Kompany says he is "very healthy" and grateful for all of the support he has recieved as he prepares to return to the dugout on Friday.

uutiset.t: Will Infantino feel he's already won as Fifa challengers confirmed?
uutiset.s: Fifa has confirmed Philippe Diallo and Kozo Tashima will also stand in next year's presidential election - but can either stop Gianni Infantino from winning?

uutiset.t: Eight-year ban for player who threw rock that hit assistant referee
uutiset.s: Ecuadorian footballer Jhon Perlaza is banned for eight years after hitting an assistant referee with a rock during a third-tier match.

uutiset.t: Wainwright and Adams back for Wales against Australia
uutiset.s: Wales make four changes to their starting line-up that beat the All Blacks for the Nations Championship meeting with Australia.
